source_clause: PRACC5.) If no custom Profile is set up, or all profiles are deleted, there will always be a default, non-connected profile in the vehicle. For first time use this default is called “Driver 1”. If Driver 1 Profile was customized (even if the name was maintained as Driver 1) and then all profiles have been deleted from the Head Unit, the default “Driver 1” Profile will return as the single profile in the vehicle (unless there are 2 or more memory seat buttons).
leaf_desc_037: The default “Driver 1” Profile will return as the single profile in the vehicle (unless there are 2 or more memory seat buttons).
reasoning: 驗證目標：4.5（PRACC5）第三句之後半 —— 重建之 “Driver 1” 為車上**唯一**之 profile。關鍵情境條件：條文自帶之例外（座椅鍵 ≥ 2）以 pre-condition 排除，使「唯一」之斷言成立。為什麼這樣切：與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-007-02` 之分野在斷言對象 ——-02 驗**重建發生**，本條驗**重建後只有一個**。**ER2 為缺席斷言（無其他 profile）**，只驗 Driver 1 在，一個留下殘餘 profile 之實作會通過。

tcs.tc_title: Recreated Driver 1 is the single Profile on the vehicle
tcs.test_item:
Recreated Driver 1 is the single Profile on the vehicle
(Verifies that no Driver Profile other than the rebuilt Driver 1 is listed after every Profile has been deleted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The default Profile has been customized and its name is still “Driver 1”
2. The vehicle has fewer than 2 memory seat buttons
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Delete every Profile from the head unit
2. Open the “All Profiles” tab
3. Read the Profile list and check that “Driver 1” is the only Profile present
tcs.expected_result:
1. Every Profile is deleted
2. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
3. “Driver 1” is present and no other Driver Profile is listed
tcs.priority_basis: 重建後之單一 profile 形態；其座椅數條件為分支
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: 條文之 `(unless there are 2 or more memory seat buttons)` 為**適用條件**，以 pre-condition 固定為少於 2 個；座椅鍵 ≥ 2 之情形由 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-008`（4.5.1）承擔。**W-1（33 包）**：刪除動作原置於 pre-condition，而 4.5 明載全部刪除後**系統立即重建預設** —— 該前提所述之穩態不存在，且其蘊含之結果即本條之 ER。已移入 procedure（比照 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-007-02`）。**與該 leaf 之分野不變**：`007-02` 驗**重建發生**（且其偏好為預設值），本條驗**重建後只有一個**。
